name: Guesty
positioning: The property management system for professional short-term rental operators, built around the channel.
description: Guesty is a short-term and vacation rental management platform: channel management across Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and others, unified inbox, automated guest messaging, direct booking websites, payments, cleaning and task automation, and revenue tools.
real_estate_use: A manager running two hundred apartments across four booking platforms faces a double-booking risk on every listing and a message volume no team can answer manually. Guesty synchronises availability and rates across channels, automates the guest message sequence from booking to checkout, and triggers the cleaning task the moment a stay ends.
features: Multi-channel synchronisation of availability, rates and reservations
Unified guest inbox with automated messaging sequences
Direct booking website and payment processing
Cleaning and maintenance task automation per turnover
Revenue management and dynamic pricing integrations
Owner reporting and statements for managed properties

use_cases.job: Run hundreds of listings across four booking channels without double bookings
Receive owner statements on short-term rental income from a manager
